assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one independent transparent PNG game terrain sprite for 茶园物语, a 2D Chinese tea-growing management game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: existing Figma tea garden scene. Generate a NEW standalone component from this visual language, not a screenshot or UI mockup.
Primary request: a single small mature tea-field plot, one gently rounded rhombus of warm pale earthen ground with a very low grey-green dry-stone retaining edge, containing two staggered orderly rows of three waist-low tea shrubs. Bushes are grown tea plants, densely rounded but not spherical, tiny fresh spring buds and a few pairs of light yellow-green tender leaves are visibly distinguishable above darker grey tea-green foliage. Rich enough for a hand-painted game sprite, controlled detail.
Style: Chinese guofeng hand-painted light mineral watercolor, restrained gongbi botanical detail, thin warm grey-brown contour lines, matte subtle paper-like texture only on the object, compatible with the reference scene. Colors sage grey-green, muted tea green, pale bamboo yellow, soft stone grey, light earth brown.
Projection: parallel 2:1 dimetric / axonometric game view, ground axes approximately 26.6 degrees from horizontal in opposite directions, vertical plants vertical, no vanishing point and no foreground enlargement. Long horizontal diamond footprint, show both front sides. Soft light from upper-left, minimal contained contact shadows, no strong cast shadow.
Composition: landscape canvas approximately 1536x1024, ONE centered plot, fully visible with generous transparent margins on all four sides, no cropped leaves or stones. A clean silhouette suitable to place on a separate ground background.
Critical: genuine transparent alpha outside the plot. NO colored background, NO white paper rectangle, NO baked checkerboard. No buildings, paths, people, fences, tools, icons, labels, interaction markers, text, numbers, borders, title, logo or watermark. Do not render a whole environment or multiple variants. This is a first style sample, not a seamless tile.

assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE standalone reusable transparent PNG popup panel BASE for 茶园物语, no embedded controls or text.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the existing Figma UI reference board. Generate a new standalone component matching the cream paper, fine bronze-gold double outlines, restrained Chinese landscape and bamboo ornament language seen in that board.
Primary request: a large horizontally oriented cream parchment popup backplate, a single continuous rectangular panel with subtly scalloped clipped corners and an elegant thin double warm ochre / bronze border. This is ONLY the backplate. The center and the top header area must remain entirely blank for runtime text and child widgets. The central 75 percent of the usable surface should be clean pale warm ivory, subtle low-contrast paper grain.
Decoration: very faint grey-green ink mountain vignette near the bottom-left border and a small delicate grey-green bamboo sprig in the top-right border, a few very thin pale gold cloud curls confined to edges. Restrained and legible. No decorative element intrudes into the central content zone. No calligraphy, seals, medallions or leaf icons.
Style: Chinese guofeng hand-painted light watercolor, matte paper, thin consistent brown-gold linework, same visual density and low saturation as reference, no photoreal material, no 3D bevel or glossy highlights. Fine details still clear when panel displayed at 960x600.
Composition: front-facing flat UI geometry, landscape canvas approximately 1536x1024. Panel occupies about 86 percent of canvas width and 76 percent height, complete silhouette with transparent external margins. No perspective. A single panel, not a sheet, moodboard or complete UI screen.
Critical: paper center is opaque; outside the panel and edge ornament is genuine transparent alpha. No white full-canvas background, no baked checkerboard. NO title tab, NO close button, NO confirm button, NO item slots, NO tabs, NO icons, NO text of any language, NO numbers, NO sample content, NO logo or watermark. Those will be separate components later. Preserve continuous straight border sections suitable for future nine-slice preparation; the ornaments in this sample still require a fixed-scale display until separately extracted.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE full-body dialogue character portrait on genuine transparent background for Chinese healing tea game 茶园物语.
Input image 1 is the EXISTING CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE. Input image 2 is the existing Figma scene STYLE REFERENCE. Create a new hand-painted rendering of the same character, blending its charm with the scene. Do not invent a different protagonist.
Preserve identity: youthful softly androgynous tea apprentice; fluffy short bob of muted teal-green hair, ends flick slightly outward, small curled tuft at the top; gentle brown eyes, round youthful face, quiet slightly curious neutral expression. Preserve the compact adorable silhouette, approximately four to four-and-a-half heads tall, not adult realistic or exaggerated giant head. Preserve clothing and accessories from image 1: soft ivory crossed inner collar shirt; loose muted grey-green outer labor jacket, voluminous sleeves gathered back at forearms; loose pale grey-taupe baggy trousers gathered at ankles, muted teal cloth shoes; tan round pendant hanging centrally at the collar; small pale peach-tan cloth pouch at the character's left hip (viewer right), with visible shoulder strap and tied mouth. Keep small trouser side ties. No new embroidery, armor, weapon, hat, elaborate headdress or jewelry.
Pose: full body facing viewer, relaxed slight three-quarter turn, shoulders unraised, one hand gently gathers opposite sleeve as in reference, natural simple visible hands, both feet fully visible. Cloth pouch must read as a soft fabric bag, not a teapot or gourd.
Style: gentle Chinese guofeng hand-painted light watercolor animation illustration, restrained fine warm grey-brown linework replacing pure black heavy contours, subtle cotton folds and matte brush texture, soft understated facial rendering, no dramatic rim light, restrained detail coherent with the Figma scene. Colors low saturation tea grey-green, sage, ivory, taupe, muted warm bamboo brown, preserve teal hair.
Composition: vertical canvas approximately 1024x1536, ONE centered character with ample transparent margins around hair, hands, pouch, shoes. No inset faces, turnaround panels or multiple poses.
Critical: genuine transparent alpha around the character. No paper background, no colored rectangle, no checkerboard baked into pixels, no frame, no shadow oval, no landscape, no prop separate from worn pouch, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Retain identifiable features without adding a new character gender narrative. This is a static dialogue portrait style sample, not an animation sheet.
